programs.title: Ford v Ferrari
programs.desc: The victory in the prestigious race goes to the Ferrari team every year.Henry Ford II intends to dethrone the full-time champion.He thinks about building a car that will leave the competition behind.For this purpose, he asks for help from two specialists.One of them is the temperamental fast driving enthusiast Ken Miles.The second one is Carroll Shelby, who can boast of winning Le Mans, and some time ago, due to health problems, he gave up his driving career and took up car design.They both immediately take up the challenge, even though they know that there is a long way to achieve their goal.They quickly encounter resistance from officials.It turns out that they must immerse themselves in the world of ruthless bureaucracy to take part in the twenty-four-hour race.

programs.title: Georgie \u0026 Mandy'S First Marriage 2
programs.desc: Young married couple Georgie and Mandy are raising their daughter, learning everyday life in their new role as parents.Each day brings new challenges and fatigue that puts their relationship to the test.

programs.title: Anaconda
programs.desc: Doug (Jack Black) and Griff (Paul Rudd) have been friends since childhood.They have always dreamed of making a remake of their favorite film, the horror film "Anaconda".When both buddies experience a midlife crisis, they decide not to wait any longer and set off together deep into the Amazon to start filming.The situation becomes more complicated when... a real giant anaconda appears on the film set, spreading chaos and destruction around.Despite the deadly threat, the friends decide to take advantage of the predator's presence.

programs.title: Blue Moon
programs.desc: The year is 1943. The legendary lyricist Lorenz Hart (Ethan Hawke), co-author of such hits as "Blue Moon" and "My Funny Valentine", spends the night from March 31 to April 1 in Sardi's bar.In the company of friends, including his muse Elizabeth Weiland (Margaret Qualley), he struggles with wounded pride and shaken self-confidence.At this time, his former long-time collaborator Richard Rodgers (Andrew Scott) celebrates the premiere of his musical entitled"Oklahoma!", which he wrote with Oscar Hammerstein II (Simon Delaney).Two Oscar nominations.

programs.title: Insecure 3
programs.desc: The further fate of Issa Dee (Issa Rae), a young African-American woman living in Los Angeles.The girl, despite numerous humiliations and lack of self-confidence, tries to live her own way.Her best friend is self-absorbed lawyer Molly (Yvonne Orji).However, their relationship is going through a crisis.Issa tries to overcome her weaknesses with varying degrees of success.He begins to question his role in the non-governmental organization where he works.He earns money as a driver.She's also trying to pick up the pieces after her breakup with Lawrence.Trying to save extra money, she stays with her former partner and childhood friend, Daniel, who is working on developing his musical career.Meanwhile, Molly starts a new job.She is surprised that she is not immediately considered a star in the new law firm.This affects her self-confidence.The third season of a brilliant comedy series about the life of an insecure young African-American woman.The production tells the story of a generation of twenty-somethings lost in the world of today, their friendships, experiences, joys and problems.The originator of the series, its producer and the main actress is the talented Issa Rae (series "First").She gained fame through her website The Misadventures Of Awkward Black Girl and her YouTube channel (over 200,000 followers and 20 million views).The other characters are played by, among others:Yvonne Orji (series "Love That Girl!") and Lisa Joyce ("It's Never Too Late").The production was nominated for a Golden Globe.

programs.title: The Last of Us 2
programs.desc: Five years have passed since Ellie (Bella Ramsey) and Joel (Pedro Pascal)'s dangerous journey.They both still function in a world whose rules are dictated by a pandemic caused by cordyceps.At first it is easier for them because they live in the city of Jackson, where they have many friends.However, when the man is caught up in the revenge of Abby Anderson (Kaitlyn Dever), the daughter of a doctor from Salt Lake City, and the soldiers from her unit - the Wolves - Ellie has no choice but to leave the town to find her and retaliate.She is accompanied on a dangerous expedition by her friend, Dina (Isabela Moner).

programs.title: 4 from there
programs.desc: Another installment of the adventures of people living in a town straight from a nightmare.It is a terrifying place that traps anyone who crosses its borders.Desperate residents fight to stay alive.

programs.title: House of the Dragon 2
programs.desc: The second series of the production, the events of which precede the action of "Game of Thrones".After the death of Lucerys Velaryon, the son of Queen Rhaenyra Targaryen (Emma D'Arcy), which was caused by his cousin, Aemond Targaryen (Ewan Mitchell), Westeros finds itself on the brink of a bloody civil war.The Green Council supporting King Aegon (Tom Glynn-Carney) and Queen Rhaenyra's Black Council are fighting for influence.Each side claims the Iron Throne.The dynamic development of events also affects the attitude of Rhaenyra's husband, Daemon (Matt Smith), in life.A man who spends a lot of time in Harrenhal Castle, away from his wife, changes a lot.In addition, the demons of his past begin to haunt him.

programs.title: Dope Girls
programs.desc: A widowed single mother, Kate is perceived by those around her as a calm person with conservative views.To provide for his family, he decides to take a surprising step - he opens a nightclub.

programs.title: Caught Stealing
programs.desc: 1990s. Former baseball player Hank Thompson (Austin Butler) works as a bartender in a New York pub.He has a great girlfriend (Zoë Kravitz) and a championship-fighting team.His calm and orderly life changes when his neighbor Russ (Matt Smith) asks him to look after his cat for a few days.Then, out of nowhere, a gang of gangsters attacks Hank.Puerto Ricans, Russians and Jews are out to get him and he has no idea why.He will only find out what's going on if his wits and luck allow him to stay alive long enough.
